subject: Close timeline reset — revised MAP, risk audit, and acceptance dates
messages:
From: Sarah Green <sarah.green@acmecorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + acceptance dates — slippage alert

Jordan —

Quick note: the evaluation team flagged a risk that will push our acceptance window by ~2 weeks. Procurement has also paused signatures pending a SOC evidence addendum. We know this impacts your go‑live target. Can you send an updated mutual action plan and a short risk audit so our execs can sign off?

Key constraints from our side:
- Security needs an additional SOC 2&A evidence artifact by 7/7
- Acceptance window ideally remains in the week of 7/21 but we may need to shift
- Procurement wants a one‑page summary of contract redline status

Can you confirm who on your side will own the re‑baseline and provide a quick timeline?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Green
Director, Product Evaluation — Acme Corp

[Attachment: evaluation_snapshot.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Green <sarah.green@acmecorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.inference, priya.natarajan@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + acceptance dates — slippage alert

Sarah —

Thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the pause. I own the MAP re‑baseline on our side; Priya (CS lead) will run the eval gates with your team and Laura will coordinate procurement artifacts.

Immediate plan (high level):
1) By EOD 6/30: share a one‑page MAP update and a risk audit (attached).
2) By 7/2: deliver the updated acceptance checklist and SOC evidence pointer.
3) If procurement remains paused, propose a soft acceptance week the week of 7/28 and a hard go‑live contingency for 8/4.

Attached: acme_map_v2.pdf (updated MAP) and a first pass slippage_risk_log.xlsx.

We can jump on a 15‑minute call today if you want to triage.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
M: (415) 555‑0198

[Attachments: acme_map_v2.pdf (pdf), slippage_risk_log.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MAP rebaseline — checklist and owners

Jordan / Laura — quick internal note after Jordan's reply to Sarah. Points to confirm before we send the formal version to Acme: 
- Laura to own procurement artifact bundle (contract redline summary + signature status).
- I will coordinate eval gating (test harness access, prompt set, acceptance metrics).
- Jordan to draft the revised timeline and escalate if procurement hold persists past 7/3.

Priority items for the risk log (already in slippage_risk_log.xlsx):
- Dependency: SOC evidence addendum (Acme security) — severity: high — mitigation: provide SOC2 mapping doc + pointer to our audit repo by 7/2.
- Procurement: signature hold — severity: medium — mitigation: one‑page summary and exec ask.
- Performance: minor tokenization edge cases discovered during eval — severity: low — mitigation: quick patch + canary by 7/10.

I updated the spreadsheet with ownership columns. If procurement confirms hold, we should trigger a go‑to exec escalation and request a 2‑week buffer.

Priya
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced: slippage_risk_log.xlsx (see folder)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Green <sarah.green@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: MAP update + risk audit + proposed rebaseline (Acme)

Sarah / team —

Following up with the formal MAP update and a short risk audit attached. TL;DR: procurement hold and SOC evidence request create a probable 10–14 calendar day slip to acceptance. We propose the following rebaseline: 

Revised timeline proposal:
- 7/02: Deliver SOC mapping doc and acceptance checklist (completed).
- 7/07: Acme security review complete (target).
- 7/14: Final acceptance dry run (if security clears).
- 7/21–7/25: Official acceptance window (soft target).
- 8/04: Hard go‑live contingency (if procurement signature delayed).

Actions required from Acme:
- Security: confirm SOC evidence review by 7/07 or notify us immediately if delayed.
- Procurement: advise on signature ETA or confirm paused status so we can escalate.

We recommend a short exec sync if procurement remains paused past 7/03. I've attached the slippage_risk_log.xlsx with RAG statuses and owners populated.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

[Attachments: slippage_risk_log.xlsx (xlsx), acme_map_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Green <sarah.green@acmecorp.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 17:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP update + risk audit + proposed rebaseline (Acme)

Sarah / Jordan —

Procurement here — thanks for the clear plan. To confirm: Acme procurement is still reviewing the final T&Cs; signature is currently on hold pending the SOC evidence addendum. I have attached our formal hold notice for your records. We can expedite the signature once security confirms the mapping.

We accept the proposed soft acceptance week of 7/21 and will aim to have signatures by 7/11 if security review is positive. If the SOC review extends beyond 7/07, please notify us immediately so we can coordinate an exec‑level decision.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference

[Attachment: procurement_hold_notice.pdf (pdf)]
